'''Loovar candies''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] often used the candies to distract [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] officer [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Borvil Mish]] from properly checking her cargo.
